The supplied baseline scored 1034.6–1071.2 GFLOP/s, and the prior panel experiment showed no repeatable gain over paired controls, so it does not support a performance claim for either proposal. Rank constant_shape_512 first because its guarded path can leave the general fallback and existing transpose unchanged, which limits correctness risk. Rank cache_conflict_layout second: changing the pack stride, both compute-loop loads, and pointer rewinds creates more bounds and alignment risks, with no supplied evidence that cache conflicts limit performance.
